modes.label: Comma inside count
modes.description: The thousands comma partway through a subject count.

modes.label: Equals sign after n
modes.description: The equals sign after n in a sample-size statement.

card.writes: It suppresses the letter n, so it pushes the model away from writing n and toward continuing with digits.
